line: 78% of customers buy from whichever business responds to them first.
Most businesses take 8 to 12 hours to answer a new email. Most of those leads are already gone by then.
This AI agent answers every new email in under a minute — before anyone even opens the inbox.
It's built on n8n: a Gmail trigger, one AI step, and a reply node. Free to build, running in the background the whole time.
The reply sits as a draft, ready in one click — or sends itself, for teams that want that.
Either way, the customer who emailed at 2am gets an answer by 2:01.
